title: Polynomial-Time Computability of the Radius Bits
statement: For every nondeterministic finite Turing machine $N$ and natural numbers $d,c,A,a$, the function sending a Boolean word $y$ to the binary expansion, in the specified list representation, of $2d(|x|+1)^c$ is polynomial-time computable, where $x$ is the first component extracted from $y$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic finite Turing machine $N$ over Boolean symbols
